title: A course pack's checklist puzzle (courses/<id>/puzzles/<name>.json)
description: Check each thing in turn (the gear rack's tools and versions, run one per press; the practice session's readout). Every puzzle file has an `id`, its `mechanic`, and may set `disabled` (the site stays as scenery), `text` (its words by key, `{name}` filled in by the game) and `lines` (its voice line ids by what they're for). docs/specs/COURSE-PACKS.md §4.

quest.description: The quest the puzzle plays in (a quest of this course): the steps its mechanic sets and waits on (PUZZLE_STEPS, src/course/puzzles.ts) are that quest's.

steps.description: The mechanic's steps (PUZZLE_STEPS) that the quest calls something else: game step → the quest's step.

disabled.description: The course turns this puzzle off: its site stays as scenery and its cue does nothing.

text.description: The puzzle's words by key (labels, hints, readouts, signs).

lines.description: Voice line ids (voice/lines.json) by what they're for.

stale.description: What the check prints the first time you run it instead (an out-of-date version the course wants you to catch), and the script of this file's `scripts` it plays then. The next run prints `output`.

notes.description: A tip shown with the check's result on one kind of computer (the player's, from Your setup or the browser), as the keeper's caption.

scripts.description: The gear rack's scripts: `intro` (the first press while its quest is at its checks), `checked` (every check has passed; it moves the quests on), and any a stale check names.

you.description: The line shows a Your setup value: the game marks it as yours.
